propositions: fetcher._iter_pages terminates on a short page and advances by requested page_size instead of actual page length, causing 92% of issues to be silently lost from the inbound snapshot when Jira truncates pages below the requested size

the pager must advance by len(page) and terminate only on empty pages, with an offset-stall guard that raises SilentTruncationError if a server ignores startAt and returns the same non-empty page repeatedly
this defect affects core fetcher code shared by both Jira Data Center and Cloud adapters, creating a wider blast radius than adapter-local truncation issues in adapters/jira_datacenter/transport.py
existing cap and ceiling semantics and the same-token-twice cursor-stall guard for Cloud must remain unchanged by the fix to preserve the Cloud contract
